variants.name: structured_json
variants.prompt_suffix: Return exactly one JSON object and no other text. Use this schema: {"evidence":["table field and year"],"formula":"numeric arithmetic formula","value":0,"unit":"million|percent|dollars|shares|"}. Preserve the table column, row, year, and unit in evidence. The value must be the final answer.

variants.name: evidence_operation
variants.prompt_suffix: Return exactly one JSON object and no other text. Do not output a final value or explanation. Every table cell is labeled [cell_id=rNcM]. Use this schema: {"evidence":[{"cell_id":"r1c2","value":"exact cell value"}],"operands":[0,0],"operation":"subtract","unit":"million|percent|dollars|shares|"}. Evidence must use existing cell IDs and copy the exact cell value. Every operand must be copied from a numeric evidence cell, in calculation order. subtract, divide, ratio, percent_change, and absolute_difference require exactly two operands; add and multiply require at least two. For percent_change use [new, old] and unit percent. operation must be one of add, subtract, absolute_difference, multiply, divide, average, ratio, percent_change. The program calculates the final answer deterministically.
